baseShaDrift.detail: Expected-Base-SHA is the grandparent of HEAD; the two intervening commits are the parent task's own evidence artifacts (TB-SHIPPING-MVP-ADMIN-050 RESULT.bridge.txt/post-result.js/results.json). No source, contract, migration or config differs. Pre-existing unrelated dirty files preserved; no reset/stash/rebase/force-push.

isolationMethod: CDP Runtime.evaluate injected in-page interception of window.fetch for /v1/admin/shipping-services* plus window.confirm, into the already-running dev page; every other request (including /v1/admin/languages) passed through to the real backend. Durable in-repo equivalent: an in-memory Fulfillment fixture installed on globalThis.fetch.

requestLogSummary: 16 requests total for the whole run, each explained by a user action; no phantom writes, no duplicate writes, and zero writes on validation failure or declined confirmation.
noLiveSideEffects: Fixture removed and original fetch/confirm restored after the run; the page reloaded against the real API still shows the untouched Development catalog (post 1/2 بله, tipax 2/2 بله, snapp_courier 0/0 خیر, store_courier 0/0 بله, in_person 0/0 بله). No DB write, no Host restart, no new route, no backend/contract/migration/checkout change, no fake Shipping rate or coverage control.

harnessLimitation: Tests run on node --experimental-strip-types, which cannot import .tsx JSX, and jsdom/Playwright/React Testing Library are not part of the existing frontend test setup; adding a framework was out of scope, so no durable React-render test could be added. The durable regression is the fetch-level roundtrip test, and the UI-level proof is the isolated browser run.
limitations: Responses came from an in-memory fixture; the Postgres persistence of the same contract is covered by existing backend tests, not by this run.
The native confirm dialog rendering was not exercised (its boundary, message text and both answers were).
New services still accept free-text code/providerKind although the shipment path only accepts the five ShippingMethodRegistry codes - belongs to the rate/coverage milestone.
